# Parūpahārakathā (Kv 2.1)
**ID:** Kv 2.1
**Section:** Kathāvatthu (kv)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Parūpahārakathā
**SuttaCentral:** https://suttacentral.net/kv2.1
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh03m3.mul9.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
In the text's dialectical progression, the opponent attempts to substantiate the proposition by pointing out that others may provide (*upasaṁhareyyum*) the material requisites to an arahant, thereby asserting *parūpahāra* in a material sense [Skorupski 1991; Williams 2005].
Within the Pali Canon, SuttaCentral links the text with the *Muṭṭhassatisutta* (AN 5.210) and the *Cīvarakkhandhaka* (Kd 8) [SuttaCentral]. Automatically detected text-reuse data from DharmaNexus reflects its shared dialectical architecture with the neighboring discussions of the Five Points, showing heavy formulaic overlap with *Aññāṇakathā* (Kv 2.2), *Kaṅkhākathā* (Kv 2.3), *Paravitāraṇakathā* (Kv 2.4), and *Parihānikathā* (Kv 1.2) [DharmaNexus; Skorupski 1991]. DharmaNexus also records recurring phraseology shared with *Sandaka Sutta* (MN 76), sections of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 5, AN 8) and *Saṁyutta Nikāya* (SN 3, SN 55), as well as automatic alignments with the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (T 26) and Tibetan treatises such as the *Yogācārabhūmi* [DharmaNexus].

- Mentioned in (SuttaCentral): AN 5.210 Muṭṭhassatisutta; Kd 8 Cīvarakkhandhaka
- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Aññāṇakathā (Kv 2.2) (§31.3_4–42.4 ↔ §15.3–27.4); Kaṅkhākathā (Kv 2.3) (§31.3_4–36.6 ↔ §10.11–14.9); Paravitāraṇakathā (Kv 2.4) (§36.9–40.6 ↔ §14.8–16.7); Parihānikathā (Kv 1.2) (§27.1–29.3 ↔ §91.2–93.3); Antarābhavakathā (Kv 8.2) (§44.4–44.5 ↔ §12.9–12.10); Sandaka Sutta (MN 76 (PTS MN i 513)) (§24.1_1–24.1_2 ↔ §8.13_1–8.13_2); Gihissaarahātikathā (Kv 4.1) (§27.11–27.13 ↔ §2.3–2.5); Atthiarahatopuññūpacayotikathā (Kv 17.1) (§43.6–44.1 ↔ §6.14–6.16)
- Cross-language matches (DharmaNexus): འཕགས་པ་དགེ་བའི་རྩ་བ་ཡོངས་སུ་འཛིན་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ། (ārya-kuśalamūla paridhara-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra) (D0101) [bo]; 中阿含經 (ZH_T01_0026) [zh]; རྣལ་འབྱོར་སྤྱོད་པའི་ས། (yogācārabhūmi) (D4035) [bo]
